state: READY_TO_APPEND — NOT YET IN THE QUEUE
why_not_appended_now: DOMAIN COACHING R5 closed on 2026-10-26 with CoachingCore/scripts/verify-r5.mjs as the default `npm run verify`. It asserts exactly 114 queue items and rewrites CoachingCore/r5/VERIFICATION.json when run, so appending now would turn R5's recorded closure evidence into a FAIL. The next mission that owns the queue (DOMAIN_COACHING_R6 or an explicit Chief/Founder act) appends these three items verbatim, keeps the 114 earlier items byte-identical, and bumps queue_revision.

items.approved_scope: Reusable allocation envelope for person-chosen training days (DR-112) only under every listed condition; no exact workout or dose is approved.
conditions: Each chosen day carries a session of a supported family for that sport and profile; the weekly load is set first from goal, recent practice (ONB-08), phase and approved policy, then distributed across the chosen days. More days never raise the weekly load nor lower the per-session floor below a supported recipe.

High frequency is judged against the person's own recent frequency and volume, never a universal count: shorter, easier sessions inside approved recipes first; if a chosen day cannot be a supported session for the profile, or too few days serve the goal, the onboarding names the fact and the person decides (ON-V7/V7b). The app never drops a chosen day and never invents a frequency ceiling.

Long-run adjacency is handled by content, never by moving days: heaviest lower-body, eccentric-dominant or novel strength work stays away from the day before the long run when the chosen days allow; otherwise lower-body demand is reduced by content and the trade-off explained; in Strength-first the long run's content may flex. No hour-based spacing rule (POL-07).

On a day with both sports in different shifts, the person's shift choice fixes the order; the coach protects the priority through the content of the earlier session; only the person moves sessions (EDT-02).

HOLD, a reported limitation or an out-of-coverage case may reduce a session, replace it with recovery or retain it, always explained and never by silently removing the day. Persistent pain, injury or illness route to CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED with no substitute dose.
re_review_triggers: New systematic review on training frequency/volume distribution or running injury and single-run spikes.
Real-use data showing chosen-day adherence or adverse patterns; change to the V1 population or objectives.
Definition of the 'supported session' recipe floor; Founder funding declaration and qualified-human revalidation.

items.approved_scope: Reusable rule for confirmed back-to-back strength and running sessions in the same shift only under every listed condition.
conditions: Back-to-back is allowed only when the person chose the same day and shift for both sports and confirmed 'fazer em sequência'; the confirmation is a changeable preference, not an inference.

Order follows the day's key session and the declared priority: Força primeiro → strength first; Corrida primeiro → the run first when it is that day's key run (quality, long or race-specific), strength first equally defensible when the run is easy, with an explanation; Equilíbrio → the day's key session first, and if both are key the trade-off is asked, never silently run-first. The person can always swap the order.
No hour or minute rule and no claim about recovery between the two parts (POL-07).

Where the chosen days allow, avoid a demanding key session of one sport straight before a demanding key session of the other through content allocation, not by moving days; if unavoidable, lower the non-priority session's demand under approved policy and explain it.
A double counts as two sessions, not a third load event or a fatigue score; the combined length is shown only as a logistics fact.
re_review_triggers: New systematic review or meta-analysis on intra-session sequence and the interference effect.
Correction or retraction of a cited source; adverse or contrary comparable observations.
Founder funding declaration and qualified-human revalidation.

items.approved_scope: Reusable boundary for the strength exercise-rotation preference only under every listed condition; cadences are preferences, not evidence-optimal values; the rotation recipe itself is not approved.
conditions: Rotation means exercise selection only and swaps an exercise for one that preserves the essential stimulus (same target muscles and pattern role, comparable demand, available equipment, the person's competence); systematic, never random or redundant (change_reason PROGRAMMED_VARIATION).

The first session with a new exercise is a calibration exposure: load set from effort (RIR/RPE) under the approved autoregulation policy, never carried over by formula; no exact first-exposure dose is approved.

'Fixo' keeps the selection; eligible substitutions (equipment, discomfort or restriction) always need the person's agency; persistent pain or a new limitation goes to CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED, not to a substitution.

Until a rotation policy is SSCTR-reviewed, 'O coach decide' keeps the selection within a block and changes at block transitions or for a stated purpose; its 'Recomendado' tag derives from approved policy, never pre-selects, and never means frequent unexplained changes.
re_review_triggers: New systematic review on exercise variation and strength or hypertrophy outcomes.
Definition of the rotation recipe (what changes, how many exercises, load carry-over) or of anchor-lift handling for the 2-week option.
Founder funding declaration and qualified-human revalidation.
